description: This file defines the 'Selectors' class, which manages selector engines, parsing selectors, and related utilities for the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: Selectors
classes.description: Manages selector engines, parsing, and validation within the Playwright framework.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new selector engine, ensuring it has a valid name and is not a predefined engine.

methods.name: testIdAttributeName
methods.description: Returns the current test ID attribute name used in selectors.

methods.name: setTestIdAttributeName
methods.description: Sets a new test ID attribute name for selectors.

methods.name: parseSelector
methods.description: Parses a selector string or object, determines if it needs to run in the main world, and validates engine names.
